about: The Mechanism Web (Map 2) of the efilist argument library's flagship, as data: which psychological, rhetorical or structural mechanisms drive each objection. `data` is the flagship's MAP_GRAPH_DATA literal as it stands; `by_objection` is the same links keyed by corpus objection id. Generated, never hand-edited.
data_md5_method: md5 of json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')), as tools/xsurface_v4_1_0.py
id_convention: Graph node ids are obj_<corpus id> and mech_<name>; each objection node carries entryId, the corpus id. by_objection is keyed by entryId.

primary_mechanism.measured: No link in MAP_GRAPH_DATA marks a primary mechanism, and 51 of the 82 objections link to more than one.
primary_mechanism.order: Each objection's mechanisms are listed in the literal's link order. That order is not a rank.
primary_mechanism.rule: UNRULED. Choosing one mechanism per objection is a ruling for Josiah, asked at L1 (2026-09-25). Until he rules, do not read the first-listed mechanism as primary.
